purpose: Independent research-to-experiment prototype; not an integrated agent or deployable trading strategy
hypothesis: Lagged market returns and volatility may contain enough persistence to improve a market/cash allocation relative to passive exposure after costs. Failure is an acceptable result.
data_semantics: Current-vintage monthly US research market excess returns plus RF, not a tradable instrument or historical publication-vintage dataset
label: target calendar month's market excess return
model: standardized ridge regression, unpenalized intercept, one fixed fit
allocation: 100% research market if predicted excess return > 0, otherwise RF; no shorting/leverage
uncertainty: 1000 moving-block bootstrap samples, block=12 months, seed=17, annualized arithmetic excess-return difference vs market; descriptive, not a discovery test
selection_policy: No hyperparameter/feature/threshold search. Validation reported, no refit or strategy selection. Test evaluated once per unchanged scientific specification; engineering reruns logged separately.
limits: One local CPU experiment, <1 minute expected, <100 MB artifacts; no provider model API, no broker, no paid data
stop_behavior: Stop on schema, missing month, sentinel, nonfinite value, split, alignment or provenance failure; preserve raw input and failure; never silently substitute synthetic data
known_risks: unknown actual historical data publication times
single market and retrospectively chosen historical periods
literature-informed design is not a pristine prospective test
